description: Find documentation by topic or task keywords when the page path is unknown. Searches page titles, navigation titles, relative paths, and page summaries, returning titles, relative paths, and summaries. Read a result with read_doc using its path and the same lang; use read_doc directly for a known path or list_docs to browse the documentation catalog. Omit lang for English; limit is 1-20 (default 5). If no results match, try broader keywords or browse list_docs. Available without an API key.

lang.description: Published documentation language (case-insensitive, e.g. zh-hant or zh-Hant). Omit for English; unavailable languages return an error.

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return (1-20, default 5).

query.description: Keywords to search for in documentation titles, navigation titles, paths, and summaries.

name: search_docs
title: Search Documentation
